filename: Interpretable Machine Learning-based Radiation Emulation for ICON.pdf
title: Interpretable Machine Learning-based Radiation Emulation for ICON
parameterization_target: radiative heating rates and surface/TOA fluxes
code_availability: The code will be published under https://github.com/EyringMLClimateGroup/hafner24jgrml MLradiationemulation offline. The software code for the ICON model is available from https://icon-model.org.
testbed_rationale: The simulation dataset itself does not have an explicit open data download URL or repository specified (only the ML code repo is provided, along with the ICON model source URL).
pain_points: Larger errors under cloudy sky conditions compared to clear sky conditions due to horizontal cloud heterogeneity at coarse scales
Omits interactive aerosols and varying greenhouse gases (fixed annual mean CO2)
Independent prediction of vertical heating rates and boundary fluxes does not guarantee exact conservation/energy consistency, though checked a posteriori to be within ~1 W/m2
Direct flux components show lower R2 (<0) compared to diffuse and total components
extraction_notes: The manuscript describes an offline emulation of the RTE+RRTMGP scheme within ICON-A. Online coupling is planned for future work.
